description.la: Explanatio Apocalypsis libris tribus, cum epistola ad Eusebium (Hwaetberhtum) et epigrammate de Ioanne.
description.en-US: Bede's three-book exposition of the Apocalypse of St. John, written for Abbot Eusebius (Hwaetberht) of Wearmouth-Jarrow, following Primasius and Tyconius and reading the book as the history of the Church. Latin text of Migne (PL 91-93); no public-domain English translation is known.
description.pt-BR: A exposição de Beda ao Apocalipse de São João, em três livros, escrita para o abade Eusébio (Hwaetberht) de Wearmouth-Jarrow, seguindo Primásio e Ticônio e lendo o livro como história da Igreja.

sources.edition: Explanatio Apocalypsis on Latin Wikisource, from the Corpus Corporum TEI of Migne's Patrologia Latina.
sources.description: Wikitext removed; inline PL column numbers dropped; one file per book (or per part), chapter divisions kept as headings with their rubrics.
sources.tierEvidence: Eighth-century text in Migne's reprint of Giles: public domain.
